about: Board fixtures for scripts/shell-measure-proof.mjs --fixtures (TCRN-DS-SUB-135). The two finished Shell boards are measured in place (their bytes are the truth; nothing is copied here) with the board hooks of scripts/lib/shell-measure.mjs, at the boards' own screen width (1240, phones 390) in a 1240 x 900 viewport. Every gate must be green on the boards; mutations.json turns each gate red. Behaviour cannot be read from a board, so the intro, focus-loop and outside-click halves are judged on the traces below (the board's stated behaviour); on the package stories the probes of scripts/shell-measure-proof.mjs record the same traces on the real parts (stories.behaviour, TCRN-DS-SUB-137). This manifest does not touch ../manifest.json.

intro.source: G 段登入动画（每会话 1 次；刷新 0 次；reduced-motion 下 0 次）；Shell 板 C 段（只用 transform 与 opacity）；C-2 motion.intro 上限 700ms

focusLoop.source: G 段焦点回路（Esc 后回标按钮；⌘K 后到搜索框；← → 在级联列间移动）；C-7（⌘K / Ctrl+K 每个壳只注册一次）

outsideClick.source: G 段无收起钮、无常驻侧栏（点外部关闭）；C-7 临时浮层（点外部、Esc、选中即收）

packageFixture.about: Package-hook fixture (TCRN-DS-SUB-174), read with the package hooks in the same 1240 x 900 viewport: the package's pinnable-row markup and grid (base.css.ts: a link and its pin side by side in .tcrn-nav-item-row, the pin keeping its 24 track and showing with opacity), the guide-column hooks the rows will carry (data-guide and data-text = prail on the row icon and label, data-shell-col on the menu columns) and the three 07a B reading cases (彩色标, 面板对画布, 遮罩下的纸, beside a canvas text and a row on a layer above the scrim, which must not read it). green: the gates and checks that must pass on it; every contrast cell on it must read its data-expect (the 07a B numbers); storyMutations: the story mutations that must turn their gate red on it, before the real parts carry the hooks they read.

pageFixture.about: Page fixture (TCRN-DS-SUB-164, R2-28), read with the package hooks in the same 1240 x 900 viewport: the page in the paper of four closed shells, the settings and roster screens of the stories at 1240 and at the 390 phone width (ts-settings-l, ts-roster-l, ts-settings-m, ts-roster-m), each with a long page breadcrumb in the package's markup and rules (every crumb gives way and ends in an ellipsis under its title), a SettingsLayout (1040, centred) or a SplitView (from the paper's content edge: 28, on the phone 16), and the brand story's first lines (ProductLockup firstLine, TMS at the rail and lockup scales, outside any shell). green: the gates and checks that must pass on it, the two checks the boards cannot show (settingsLayout, splitView) among them; storyMutations: the story mutations that must turn their gate red on it, before the real stories carry these screens (SUB-161).

stories.about: Package-story side (TCRN-DS-SUB-137). screens: the screens each C-9 story must show, in order, with the C-5 data-state of the shell root (the board screen names of the TCRN-DS-SUB-121 stories; ts-m-s is the board's Sheet screen, so its root reads sheet). TCRN-DS-SUB-164 (R2-28, C-12) fixes the new screens and the brand story: ts-search-l is the full menu with a typed query and its results open (R2-24); ts-settings-l and ts-settings-m are the settings page (PageHeader whose breadcrumb is long, then SettingsLayout), ts-roster-l and ts-roster-m the roster page (PageHeader whose breadcrumb is long, then SplitView), closed, at 1440 and at 390. shell-brand-first-line (navigation-shells) has no shell: its screens are the first lines of the four products at the rail scale (data-lockup lkr-line, mark 22) and the lockup scale (lk-line, mark 44), ProductLockup firstLine, outside any shell, in the order listed; product is the lockup's data-product-id. behaviour: where the probes run, the focus loop and outside click on a closed screen and the arrows on a screen that shows the full menu; the intro on the intro story in a fresh session.
